crime_highlights: Mr. Clark got off his skateboard, pulled out the gun from the bag in which he had carried it, and walked towards Mr. Dalke
He testified he walked, gun-in-hand, to within three to four feet of the truck.
After Mr. Clark shot through the windshield, Mr. Dalke managed to engage the clutch and pull away from the scene.
Mr. Clark admitted he raised the gun in Mr. Dalke's and Ms. Andrews' direction.
rationale_highlights: The consequential disintegration of supportive family connections and parenting models have indirectly negatively impacted Mr. Clark's own life experience, contributing in some measure to his history of substance abuse, problems with anger control and psychological problems, and playing some part in his coming before the court on this serious offence.

the intergenerational harm stemming from the maternal grandmother's Residential School experience, and the dysfunctional family experience that in turn came from it, plays some part in Mr. Clark's being before the court today
My foregoing consideration of the Gladue factors and the fact that rehabilitation is an attainable goal caution against imposing a sentence that would unduly discourage Mr. Clark's rehabilitation.
note: Court says factor played some part; effect on sentence stated modestly.

crime_highlights: Rose Paul had been subjected to a brutal beating that, the jury found, caused her death

multiple bruises to her back and arms, multiple lacerations on her face and head, a fractured nose, a missing front tooth, seven fractures to her ribs and sternum, and a fractured hyoid bone in her neck
Mr. Paul killed this vulnerable woman who loved him by administrating a protracted and vicious beating that must have rendered the long last moments of her life truly terrifying
rationale_highlights: the only mitigating factors are those raised in the Gladue report: the systemic effect of being an intergenerational survivor of residential schools, and the associated history of dislocation, family dysfunction, abuse and alcoholism
These speak loudly to Mr. Paul's moral culpability
the Gladue factors still have some application
I conclude that the systemic Gladue factors prevalent here prevent Mr. Paul from being considered
pull him back from the brink of the maximum period of parole ineligibility
note: Parole ineligibility case; factor pulls him back from maximum.

crime_highlights: As he was being searched, Mr. Sellars dropped nine rounds of .32-calibre ammunition into the box of the truck.
He carried the Handgun with him at all times for his protection.
The search also produced an extendable baton, two knives, a small amount of marihuana and a can of mace.
rationale_highlights: The Gladue Report recognizes the negative effects of the residential school system on Mr. Sellars' parents and grandparents who were part of that system
This legacy continues to impact the lives of successive generations within Mr. Sellars' family including Mr. Sellars himself.
Mr. Sellars' background has a diminishing effect on his moral blameworthiness.
the Gladue Factors which are part and parcel of the determination of a fit sentence
note: Possession offence; no victim harm. Suspended sentence imposed.
